description: This file contains prototype declarations for internal functions related to HTTP Ato CgiEnv object, including creation of code and name tables, and retrieval of atom codes and names. It is part of the internal API for the Http Ato CgiEnv component.

methods.name: HttpAtoCgiEnvCreateCodeTable
methods.description: Creates a code table for internal use within the Http Ato CgiEnv object.

methods.name: HttpAtoCgiEnvCreateNameTable
methods.description: Creates a name table for internal use within the Http Ato CgiEnv object.

methods.name: HttpAtoCgiEnvGetAtomCode
methods.description: Retrieves the atom code associated with a given name.

methods.name: HttpAtoCgiEnvGetAtomName
methods.description: Retrieves the name associated with a given atom code.
